artworks.title: Violin Player Seated in a Tavern
artworks.medium: etching and roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a rustic interior with multiple figures engaged in various activities. The scene appears to be a lively tavern or similar setting, with wooden furniture and miscellaneous items filling the room. A person is playing a violin, seated on a bench, while others are conversing, holding papers or drinking vessels. One individual in the foreground is interacting with another standing figure, who is dressed distinctively. Objects like shelves, containers, and tools can be seen on the walls. Above, there is a loft area where individuals are sitting. The detailed line work adds depth to the bustling scene.

artworks.title: Village Festival
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene in a village or town. The illustration shows a bustling fair or festival with various activities occurring along the streets. On the left, a two-story building is depicted with people engaging in different actions. Below, a crowd is gathered with some people dancing and others partaking in drinking and merrymaking. Barrels, baskets, and stools suggest a gathering spot, and animals can be seen picking at the ground. In the middle ground, there are trees and distant tents. To the right, on a raised platform, performers entertain a crowd with banners enhancing the festive mood. The drawing includes vivid detailing of costumes, architecture, and posture, contributing to a lively and celebratory atmosphere.

artworks.title: "But surely, Mr. Shakespeare, two heads is better than one"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a film director engaged in conversation with a Shakespearean ghostly figure. The scene is illuminated dramatically, with light coming from the ghostly figure on the right. The director, seated on the left, is dressed in a suit and appears surprised, gesturing towards the figure. An old movie camera is visible in the upper left of the drawing. A caption below reads, "But surely Mr. Shakespeare two heads is better than one!"

artworks.title: Tour du gros-horloge, Evreux
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed street scene with a prominent clock tower, rooftops, a flag fluttering at the top of the tower against cloudy skies. The artistic style includes careful line work to depict architectural features and figures on the street. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray to create depth. Figures are depicted interacting on a bustling street with timber-framed buildings.

artworks.title: Rue du gros-horloge, Rouen
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The architecture consists of tall, intricately adorned buildings lining both sides of the street. In the distance, a clock tower and a domed structure are visible. The scene captures architectural details and a crowd of people on the street. The color palette is predominantly grayish-brown, giving the impression of an etching or a detailed drawing. People in period attire, carts, and a dog populate the street. The scene extends into the distance towards the archway beneath the clock tower.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew the Great, Smithfield
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting the entrance to the Priory Church of Saint Bartholomew the Great. The point of view is from ground level, showing the ornate archway and wrought iron gate leading into the church. The entrance is embellished with Gothic details. The composition is vertical, without a distinct horizon line. The etching features meticulous brushstrokes with fine lines and cross-hatching, creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic, varying in sepia tones. A figure with a cart is close by, and more figures are seen in the distance. The background shows the dark interior of the church with a lit cross.

artworks.title: The Man with the Pink
artworks.artist: Ferdinand Gaillard after Jan van Eyck
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. His body is slightly turned to the left, while his face is directed forward, looking at the viewer. The man has a strong expression with deep eyes and wrinkles on his forehead. His hair is short or shaved, and he has sharp features. He wears a loose robe with a fur collar and a braided cord with a cross pendant around his neck. He is holding a sprig with flowers in one hand and his other hand is raised with slightly curled fingers. There is a ring on his left hand. The background is plain and dark, emphasizing the man's face and upper body.

artworks.title: "Ce qui se fait dans les meilleures societes"
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals walking closely together. The person on the right is an older man holding a circular object with his right hand. He is wearing a hat and dressed in a coat. Beside him, the second person, possibly a woman, has disheveled hair and is also wearing a coat. The background shows a row of buildings with sloping roofs and the sky above is illustrated with soft strokes.

artworks.title: Histoire d'en dire deux
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of two men from the waist up. The man on the left is leaning with his head lowered, while the man on the right is turned towards him, gesturing. The man on the left has curly hair under a hat and looks disheveled, wearing a long coat and a collared shirt. The man on the right has a pointed nose and intense expression, also wearing a hat, coat, and shirt. The background is a sketchy setting, possibly depicting a rural or urban landscape with buildings in the distance, sketched using monochrome pencil lines and shadings.

artworks.title: Inner Harbor
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view across a body of water towards a small town or village in the distance. The horizon is placed just above the midline, featuring structures, likely houses with pitched roofs, and some scattered trees. Several vertical forms that resemble ship masts rise against the sky along the horizon. The brushstrokes are delicate and sketch-like, consisting of short, fine lines and dashes that give the composition an impressionistic quality. The color palette is monochrome, primarily black on a light background. In the sky, there are a few faint, wispy clouds, and the water's surface is depicted with horizontal lines suggesting gentle ripples.

artworks.title: Colonial Church, Gloucester
artworks.description: The image shows an avenue flanked by tall trees leading to a building with a tower at its center. The tower is topped with a dome or spire-like structure. There is no distinct horizon line, with the focus on the architectural elements and trees framing the scene vertically. The sketchy style includes varied strokes for texture and depth without fine detail. The color palette is grayscale, emphasizing contrasts and composition over color. The path lined with trees guides the gaze towards the distant building, bordered by trees.

artworks.title: The Broad Curtain
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person seated in a chair, holding a book or newspaper and reading. The individual has short dark hair and is wearing a light-colored garment with long sleeves. The room is well-furnished with sheer curtains, large windows, and a table with a plant and other objects to the right of the person.

artworks.title: Bathing Beach, Bass Rocks
artworks.description: This image shows a wooden bridge with people on it. The horizon is lined with trees or vegetation. The artwork has loose, sketchy brushstrokes. Closest to us, there is a shoreline with a rowboat and grasses depicted with quick lines. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray against a light background.

artworks.title: Lafayette Street
artworks.description: This image shows an urban street scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is not visible, focusing on a portion of the street and buildings. A large American flag hangs diagonally above the street. Brushstrokes are loose and impressionistic, capturing movement and energy. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and grey for contrast. Figures walk along the street, engaging in various activities, while the buildings and cityscape beyond are sketched in an abstract manner.

artworks.title: Avenue of the Allies
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene depicted in a black and white sketch style. The view is from street level, showing a bustling urban area with large flags hanging above. People are depicted with loose strokes, and buildings line the street, providing depth. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes contrasts between light and dark, highlighting detailed line work and creating a lively cityscape.

artworks.title: Wayside Inn—Oaks in Spring
artworks.description: This image shows a black and white etching of a large tree dominating the scene. The horizon is high in the image, revealing a vast landscape that extends beyond the tree. In the background, there are more trees and distant hills. The tree and surrounding foliage are detailed with cross-hatched lines to show texture and shadow. A rough path is visible on the ground, with sunlight casting shadows from the tree's limbs. The image has a monochromatic palette, focusing on line work to provide depth and dimension to the scene.

artworks.title: Old Lace
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with a small bridge and a village in the background. Two boats are floating on the water. The stone bridge crosses the water, with trees and houses in the village behind it. The artwork features detailed lines creating texture in the stonework, water, and trees. The color scheme is monochromatic, using various shades of black, white, and grey.

artworks.title: Toby's, Cos Cob
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene in front of a grand building. The artwork depicts an elaborately detailed facade of a two-story building with a porch or balcony running along its length. The lower floor features multiple, paned windows, adorned with a repeating arch pattern beneath a railing on the upper balcony. A large tree stands to the side, with its branches casting intricate shadows over the structure and ground. In the foreground, there is a cart or wagon, detailed with large wheels and a decorative panel.

artworks.title: House on the Main Street, Easthampton
artworks.description: The image shows a house partially hidden by large trees, with the trees dominating the upper portion of the scene. A wooden fence separates the viewer from the house. The house has multiple visible windows, suggesting it is two stories with a porch. The artwork features detailed line work creating texture and depth through cross-hatching and varied line density. The color scheme is monochromatic in black and white, emphasizing contrast and shadow.

artworks.title: Walt Whitman's Birthplace
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene with a house in the center, slightly to the right. The horizon is high in the composition, focusing on the immediate surroundings. There are no prominent elements directly on the horizon. The artwork features intricate linework with crosshatching techniques for texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a cream or off-white background. A wooden fence runs parallel to a dirt path leading to the house, surrounded by trees with foliage framing the scene.

artworks.title: The Laughing Audience
artworks.description: The image depicts various people in a detailed engraving style. In the upper portion, there are two women on the left and a man wearing a coat and spectacles engaged in conversation, and another playful couple to their right. In the lower half, several men are shown standing or seated with varied expressions. The background includes textured wall details and paneling, indicating a social setting.

artworks.title: Four Heads from the Raphael Cartoons at Hampton Court
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of four men, each depicted from the shoulders up in various poses. The man on the left has a beard and short hair, looking to the right. The second man from the left has curly hair and faces right with a neutral expression. The third man has longer curly hair and a beard, looking directly at the viewer with his face partially in shadow. The man on the right has a full beard and wears a head wrap, facing left with eyes nearly closed. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed features and expressions of the four men.

artworks.title: Henry Colthurst
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the bust of a person. The individual is positioned facing slightly to the left with their head turned towards the viewer. They have a young face with softly defined features, thin lips, and large eyes. Their hair is medium-length, reaching just past the chin, and appears to be wavy or slightly curled. The person is wearing what seems to be a period garment, possibly a jerkin or doublet, and a high collar is visible underneath. The background of the image features a large helmet and a small detailed figure. The background around the central figure is plain.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: This is a waist-length portrait of a man positioned forward, staring directly towards the viewer. His facial features include a solemn expression with deep-set eyes, and he has shoulder-length, wavy hair framing his face. He is wearing a wide-collared, dark garment that is fastened with buttons down the front. The image is encased within an ornate oval frame adorned with scrollwork and designs. Below the frame, there is a decorative cartouche featuring a shield with three fleur-de-lis and what appears to be a mountain or hill. The portrait is done in a vintage engraving style.
